# Paradex Docs

Welcome to the Paradex documentation repository! This is where all the documentation for Paradex lives.

## About Paradex

Paradex is a decentralized trading platform that allows users to trade digital assets directly from their wallets. It offers a secure, transparent, and efficient trading experience by leveraging blockchain technology. Paradex aims to provide a seamless and user-friendly interface for both novice and experienced traders.

# Agents instructions

# Agents instructions

Before starting any task in this repo, read all files in the `/agents/learnings/` folder to load accumulated context and avoid known pitfalls.

After completing a task, update or create a relevant learning file in `/agents/learnings/` as part of your PR.

# CONTRIBUTING.md

Source: https://github.com/tradeparadex/paradex-docs/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md

## Contributing

We welcome contributions from the community! Follow the steps below to get started.

> You can also choose to simply [submit an issue](https://github.com/tradeparadex/paradex-docs/issues/new/choose) and the team would be more than happy to look into this for you!

### Prerequisites

Make sure you have the following installed:
- [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/)
- [Yarn](https://yarnpkg.com/)

### Install Dependencies

First, clone the repository and navigate into the project directory:

```shell
git clone https://github.com/your-username/paradex-docs.git
cd paradex-docs
```

Then, install the project dependencies with:

```shell
yarn install
```

### Preview Docs

To start the Fern server and preview the documentation locally, run:

```shell
yarn dev
```

> If everything goes right, you should see a message like:
>
> ```plain
> Running server on http://localhost:3000
> ```

Visit the URL in your browser to see the documentation.

### Making Changes

1. **Create a new branch for your changes:**

    ```shell
    git checkout -b my-feature-branch
    ```

2. **Make your changes in the appropriate files.**

3. **Commit your changes with a meaningful commit message:**

    ```shell
    git commit -m "Add feature X"
    ```

4. **Push your changes to GitHub:**

    ```shell
    git push origin my-feature-branch
    ```

5. **Open a pull request on GitHub.**
